newsitem.title: USA: Met Realty offers $50 mln Class B interests.
newsitem.headline: Met Realty offers $50 mln Class B interests.

text.p: Metropolitan Realty Corp said Wednesday it will offer $50 million in Class B membership interests in its restructuring into a limited liability company.

The Detroit, Michigan-based real estate investment trust said holders of fewer than 50,000 shares of its common stock as of Wednesday, October 9, will receive a cash payment equal to $9.03 per share, the book value of their shares as of September 3o, 1995.
These shareholders would receive the payment in lieu of membership interests in the limited liability company, Metropolitan said.
The restructuring proposal is subject to shareholder approval.

The company said restructuring will be done by transferring its assets and liabilities to Metropolitan Realty Company LLC, dissolving Metropolitan Realty Corp and distributing Class A membership interests to certain Metropolitan Realty Corp shareholders.
